Handwoven Cane Planter Set — Indian Artisan Craft, Sustainably Made
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Not everything worth having is made quickly. This wasn't.

In a sunlit workshop somewhere in India, a master artisan picks up a strand of freshly harvested cane and begins. Over the next 5–7 hours, strand by strand, the planter takes shape — tight, balanced, alive. No machine can replicate this. No algorithm can replace the hands that made it.

A Material That Gives Back to the Earth

Cane is one of nature's most remarkable materials. It grows fast, requires no pesticides, and actively absorbs CO₂ as it matures — making it a carbon-negative raw material before it even reaches your home.

  • 100% natural cane — zero plastics, zero resins, zero toxins
  • Biodegradable at end of life — returns to the earth as it came
  • Harvested sustainably from managed groves
  • Each piece supports a living craft tradition and fair artisan livelihoods

When you choose this planter, you reduce your home's carbon footprint — not as a compromise, but as an upgrade.

Designed for Considered Living

This is a planter for homes where every object has been chosen, not collected. Whether it anchors a trailing monstera in your Pali Hill drawing room, frames a sculptural cactus on your Golf Links windowsill, or holds a lush fern in your Sadashivanagar study — it belongs.

The tight weave catches light beautifully. The earthy tone grounds any palette. It pairs with linen, stone, raw wood, aged brass, and silence.

Available in Four Sizes

  • Small: Height 8", Diameter 8"
  • Medium: Height 10", Diameter 10"
  • Large: Height 12", Diameter 12"
  • Set of 3: One of each — Small, Medium & Large — for a curated, layered look

A quiet act of sustainability. A piece of India’s living craft heritage. A gift that means something — for a housewarming, a birthday, or simply yourself.

seo.description: Handwoven by Indian artisans from natural cane. Carbon-negative, plastic-free & timeless. Perfect for luxury homes. Shop S, M, L & Set of 3.

Handwoven Cane Planter — Artisan Crafted, Naturally Yours
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Some things cannot be rushed. This planter wasn't.

Deep in a quiet workshop, a skilled Indian artisan spent hours weaving each strand of sustainably harvested cane — by hand, with intention. No machines. No shortcuts. Just craft passed down through generations, now living in your home.

Why This Planter is Different

In a world of mass-produced décor, this is an object with a story. Woven from natural cane — one of the fastest-growing, lowest-carbon materials on earth — each planter takes 4–6 hours of skilled handwork to complete. The tight weave, the balanced form, the quiet elegance — none of it is accidental.

Wear It Lightly on the Planet

  • Cane absorbs CO₂ as it grows, making it a carbon-negative raw material
  • Zero synthetic inputs — no plastics, no resins, no toxins
  • Biodegradable at end of life — returns to the earth as it came
  • Made by artisans earning fair wages in India's craft economy

Designed for Considered Living

Whether it holds a trailing pothos in your Bandra West study, a sculptural succulent on your Lutyens' Delhi windowsill, or a statement fern in your Koramangala living room — this planter elevates the ordinary into the intentional.

It pairs beautifully with linen, stone, raw wood, and aged brass. It belongs in spaces where every object has been chosen, not collected.

Dimensions

  • Small: Height 8", Diameter 7"
  • Large: Height 12", Diameter 10"

A thoughtful housewarming gift. A quiet act of sustainability. A piece of India's living craft heritage — in your home.
